nl:
In etc/logrotate.d/orders, replace this block:
    daily
    rotate 7

with this block:
    weekly
    rotate 4

entries.content_utf8:
Port 22
PermitRootLogin yes
PasswordAuthentication yes
PubkeyAuthentication yes
X11Forwarding no
MaxAuthTries 6
Subsystem sftp /usr/lib/openssh/sftp-server

[Unit]
Description=Orders service
After=network.target

[Service]
User=orders
ExecStart=/opt/orders/bin/orders --port 8080
Restart=on-failure

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

oracle_program:
edit "etc/logrotate.d/orders" changes: [{replace: "    daily
    rotate 7
", with: "    weekly
    rotate 4
"}] expect: 1
reference_bash:
python3 - <<'EOF'
import pathlib
p = pathlib.Path('etc/logrotate.d/orders')
t = p.read_bytes().decode('utf-8')
old = '    daily\n    rotate 7\n'
assert t.count(old) == 1
p.write_bytes(t.replace(old, '    weekly\n    rotate 4\n').encode('utf-8'))
EOF
reference_pwsh:
$p = Join-Path $PWD 'etc/logrotate.d/orders'
$t = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($p)
$old = '    daily
    rotate 7
'
$new = '    weekly
    rotate 4
'
if (([regex]::Matches($t, [regex]::Escape($old))).Count -ne 1) { throw 'expected one match' }
[IO.File]::WriteAllText($p, $t.Replace($old, $new))
